verses.original: Παῦλος δοῦλος Θεοῦ δὲ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πίστιν Θεοῦ ἐκλεκτῶν καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας τῆς κατ’ εὐσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: Paulos doulos Theou de apostolos Iēsou Christou kata pistin Theou eklektōn kai epignōsin alētheias tēs kat’ eusebeian
verses.literal: Paul a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for [the] faith of God’s elect and [their] knowledge of [the] truth that leads to godliness

verses.original: ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι αἰωνίου ζωῆς ἣν ὁ Θεὸς ἀψευδὴς ἐπηγγείλατο πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων
verses.transliteration: ep’ elpidi aiōniou zōēs hēn ho Theos apseudēs epēngeilato pro chronōn aiōniōn
verses.literal: in [the] hope of eternal life which - God who cannot lie promised before time began

verses.original: ἰδίοις καιροῖς ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ τὸν αὐτοῦ λόγον ἐν κηρύγματι ἐπιστεύθην ὃ ἐγὼ κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν Θεοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος
verses.transliteration: idiois kairois ephanerōsen de ton autou logon en kērygmati episteuthēn ho egō kat’ epitagēn Theou hēmōn tou Sōtēros
verses.literal: [In His] own time He has made . . . - His word {evident} in [the] proclamation entrusted vvv to me by [the] command of God our - Savior

verses.original: Τίτῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ κατὰ κοινὴν πίστιν Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος
verses.transliteration: Titō gnēsiō teknō kata koinēn pistin Charis kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros kai Christou Iēsou hēmōn tou Sōtēros
verses.literal: To Titus [my] true child in [our] common faith Grace and peace from God [the] Father and Christ Jesus our - Savior

verses.original: χάριν Τούτου ἀπέλιπόν σε ἐν Κρήτῃ ἵνα ἐπιδιορθώσῃ τὰ λείποντα καὶ καταστήσῃς πρεσβυτέρους κατὰ πόλιν ὡς ἐγώ διεταξάμην σοι
verses.transliteration: charin Toutou apelipon se en Krētē hina epidiorthōsē ta leiponta kai katastēsēs presbyterous kata polin hōs egō dietaxamēn soi
verses.literal: The reason . . . I left you in Crete [was] that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town as I directed you

verses.original: εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἀνέγκλητος ἀνήρ μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἔχων τέκνα πιστά μὴ ἐν κατηγορίᾳ ἀσωτίας ἢ ἀνυπότακτα
verses.transliteration: ei tis estin anenklētos anēr mias gynaikos echōn tekna pista mē en katēgoria asōtias ē anypotakta
verses.literal: [An elder must] . . . be blameless [the] husband of but one wife having children who are believers [and who are] not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination

verses.original: γὰρ ὡς Θεοῦ οἰκονόμον τὸν ἐπίσκοπον Δεῖ εἶναι ἀνέγκλητον μὴ αὐθάδη μὴ ὀργίλον μὴ πάροινον μὴ πλήκτην μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ
verses.transliteration: gar hōs Theou oikonomon ton episkopon Dei einai anenklēton mē authadē mē orgilon mē paroinon mē plēktēn mē aischrokerdē
verses.literal: - As God’s steward - an overseer must be above reproach not self-willed not quick-tempered not given to drunkenness not violent not greedy for money

verses.original: ἀλλὰ φιλόξενον φιλάγαθον σώφρονα δίκαιον ὅσιον ἐγκρατῆ
verses.transliteration: alla philoxenon philagathon sōphrona dikaion hosion enkratē
verses.literal: Instead [he must be] hospitable a lover of good self-controlled upright holy [and] disciplined

verses.original: ἀντεχόμενον τοῦ πιστοῦ λόγου κατὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἵνα ᾖ δυνατὸς καὶ παρακαλεῖν ἐν τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ καὶ ἐλέγχειν τοὺς ἀντιλέγοντας
verses.transliteration: antechomenon tou pistou logou kata tēn didachēn hina ē dynatos kai parakalein en tē hygiainousē tē didaskalia kai elenchein tous antilegontas
verses.literal: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as - it was taught so that he can . . . . . . encourage [others] by - sound - teaching and refute those who contradict [it]

verses.original: γὰρ πολλοὶ Εἰσὶν ἀνυπότακτοι καὶ ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ τῆς περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: gar polloi Eisin anypotaktoi kai mataiologoi kai phrenapatai malista hoi ek tēs peritomēs
verses.literal: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception especially those of the circumcision

verses.original: οὓς δεῖ ἐπιστομίζειν χάριν αἰσχροῦ κέρδους οἵτινες ἀνατρέπουσιν ὅλους οἴκους διδάσκοντες ἃ δεῖ μὴ
verses.transliteration: hous dei epistomizein charin aischrou kerdous hoitines anatrepousin holous oikous didaskontes ha dei mē
verses.literal: who must be silenced For [the] sake of dishonorable gain [they] undermine entire households [and] teach things they should not

verses.original: τις ἐξ αὐτῶν αὐτῶν ἴδιος προφήτης εἶπέν Κρῆτες ἀεὶ ψεῦσται κακὰ θηρία ἀργαί γαστέρες
verses.transliteration: tis ex autōn autōn idios prophētēs eipen Krētes aei pseustai kaka thēria argai gasteres
verses.literal: [As] one of - their own prophets has said Cretans [are] always liars evil beasts lazy gluttons

verses.original: αὕτη Ἡ μαρτυρία ἐστὶν ἀληθής δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἔλεγχε αὐτοὺς ἀποτόμως ἵνα ὑγιαίνωσιν ἐν τῇ πίστει
verses.transliteration: hautē Hē martyria estin alēthēs di’ hēn aitian elenche autous apotomōs hina hygiainōsin en tē pistei
verses.literal: This - testimony is true vvv vvv Therefore rebuke them sternly so that they will be sound in the faith

verses.original: μὴ προσέχοντες Ἰουδαϊκοῖς μύθοις καὶ ἐντολαῖς ἀνθρώπων ἀποστρεφομένων τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: mē prosechontes Ioudaikois mythois kai entolais anthrōpōn apostrephomenōn tēn alētheian
verses.literal: vvv [and] will pay no attention to Jewish myths [or] [to the] commands of men who have rejected the truth

verses.original: τοῖς καθαροῖς Πάντα καθαρὰ δὲ τοῖς μεμιαμμένοις καὶ ἀπίστοις οὐδὲν καθαρόν ἀλλὰ καὶ αὐτῶν ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ συνείδησις μεμίανται
verses.transliteration: tois katharois Panta kathara de tois memiammenois kai apistois ouden katharon alla kai autōn ho nous kai hē syneidēsis memiantai
verses.literal: To the pure all things [are] pure but to the defiled and unbelieving nothing [is] pure Indeed both their - minds and [their] consciences are defiled

verses.original: ὁμολογοῦσιν εἰδέναι Θεὸν δὲ τοῖς ἔργοις ἀρνοῦνται ὄντες βδελυκτοὶ καὶ ἀπειθεῖς καὶ ἀδόκιμοι πρὸς πᾶν ἀγαθὸν ἔργον
verses.transliteration: homologousin eidenai Theon de tois ergois arnountai ontes bdelyktoi kai apeitheis kai adokimoi pros pan agathon ergon
verses.literal: They profess to know God but by [their] actions they deny [Him] They are detestable - disobedient and unfit for any good deed
